name: com.xengine.gpu-animation
description: Animation Baker and Instancing: bake skinned-mesh animations into vertex animation textures (VAT) and render thousands of GPU-instanced animated characters. Official optional package: listed in Package Manager, not mounted until installed.

samples.description: Self-baking runtime crowd: procedural skinned flag + bake + 10,000 GPU-instanced instances. No pre-baked assets needed.
